# Corrow Tannery

## Liming

The Corrow lime pits are charged on Mondays with 70 kilograms of slaked lime and 3 kilograms of sodium sulphide to the pit. Hides are handled in the lime for eight days with a stir each morning.

## Bark liquors

The Corrow finishing liquor is held at 12 degrees on the Barkometer. Hides move through the pits over ten weeks and the master tests the liquor every morning.

## Drying

The Corrow loft hangs hides for seven days in summer and twelve in winter.
